quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Calamity Tier evaluation. Operating ROIC maintained at 32.26% tangible return neutralizing $13.4B goodwill/intangibles. Peak Owner EPS (145.74p) retained as through-cycle earning capacity of aged maturation stocks following Latin America channel inventory normalization. Forward growth haircut to 5.0% reflecting post-calamity capital discipline, debt reduction focus (<2.5x net debt/EBITDA), and halting of buybacks.
